prose: It's the season of fun, and as the sun traverses tropical Gemini, your favorite astro-herbalism series continues, forging ahead into the doctrine of signatures pertaining to the sign of the twins. Join us for an entertaining education on plants that project those Gemini Vibes, as Kyle Denton (Tippecanoe Herbs), Michelle Lundquist, Mario Garza and Slick Dissident bring their best weaves to the stream.
music: Vibe Rant intro theme by VOLO
